infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Mohuddle uses Face ID to unlock, so people's care records stay private if your phone is left open.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Mohuddle uses Face ID to unlock, so people's care records stay private if your phone is left open.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Mohuddle checks you are at the home when you clock in and out. Your location is only read at those moments.

plugins.microphonePermission: Mohuddle uses the microphone when you choose Speak your note. The recording is turned into words and not kept.

plugins.cameraPermission: Mohuddle uses the camera when you add a photo to an incident report, such as an injury or damage.
plugins.photosPermission: Mohuddle lets you add a photo from your library to an incident report.
